author: Binta Kanteh
headline: In Minneapolis’ Cedar Riverside, a group of mothers protect neighbors from ICE
news_topic: community protection; know-your-rights training; ICE observation; mutual aid
collection_notes: Sahan explains that the Mamas of Cedar attended a Know Your Rights training hosted by Ayada Leads and that the training supplied foundational knowledge and best practices used to protect neighbors. This is substantive organizational uptake even without a direct Ayada quote because the organization's communicative/training intervention is narratively linked to community action.
